summary: Harvard Apparatus Regenerative Technology filed an 8-K reporting two bridge loan advances from its Chairman/CEO Junli He: $200,000 on May 8, 2026 and $200,000 on July 16, 2026, each via a Bridge Note bearing 8% fixed interest. Principal and interest are due at maturity, the earlier of closing of a capital raise with gross proceeds of at least $5,000,000 or one year from issuance. The notes may convert at the lender's option into equity securities at the per-unit price of any subsequent financing raising at least $200,000. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation.
